title: Deeper/broader ACIS/SAB producer scope and AcDs test-route correction
mode: Primary-source web research and plan refinement; no code execution
scope: Resolve the ezdxf ACIS API versus FAQ claim about SAB writing.
Separate LibreDWG issue #1411's writer loss from reader qualification.
Make existing PAR-07/S8 modeler carrier and consumer probes cheaper and implementation-ready.

sources.revision: Stable documentation identifies ezdxf 1.4.5; pages accessed 2026-10-22 and are mutable
sources.observed: The specific ACIS API documents export_sat(), export_sab(), export_dxf(), and body_from_mesh(). It describes SAT for DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB for R2013/R2018. It limits geometry generation to supported polyhedral bodies, says unsupported ACIS entities can load as NONE_ENTITY with data loss, says mesh_from_body() extracts only planar faces, and states ezdxf provides no ACIS kernel. The FAQ still states SAT-only writing and no ACIS creation/editing, contradicting the specific API.
sources.limits: No package/source artifact was downloaded or run. Documentation is not proof that every export route, modeler entity, or arbitrary ACIS graph works.

sources.revision: Issue #1411 opened 2026-09-02; report names LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae764; mutable issue/source pages accessed 2026-10-22
sources.observed: The issue's public AC1032 DXF reproduction uses ezdxf to author a polyhedral SAB body, confirms entity SAB bytes and AcDsData records, then reports the LibreDWG dxf2dwg output lacks AcDsPrototype_1b and a subsequent dwg2dxf output lacks SAB. The issue separately reports an unavailable confidential AutoCAD sample. Since the public intermediate DWG lacks the target section, that route exercises a writer loss but does not qualify the DWG reader's extraction path.
sources.limits: The issue is a peer report, not independently reproduced here and not a current-release result. The confidential input was not accessed.

sources.observed: The public version matrix separates DxfReader, DxfWriter, DwgReader, and DwgWriter. It declares AC1021 DWG read but no DWG write, and declares AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 for both directions.
sources.limits: This is a project capability declaration, not runtime, per-class, AcDs, or semantic evidence. No peer package/source was run.

sources.observed: DWG import composes an external converter with the DXF importer; converter preference and fallback determine route attribution. A successful converter output does not establish downstream importer or 3D semantic behavior.
sources.limits: No FreeCAD application or native platform profile was run.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8 split ACIS/SAB DXF carrier, DWG writer section-emission, DWG reader extraction, semantic geometry, and native-consumer evidence
PAR-144 evidence admission for artifact identity, source-section presence, per-owner association, and independent semantic checks

planChanges: Corrected a stale comparison row: the specific ezdxf ACIS API documents SAB export for bounded polyhedral bodies even though its FAQ still says SAT-only; arbitrary ACIS editing and kernel behavior remain unsupported.
Reclassified the public LibreDWG #1411 reproduction as evidence of loss on its reported dxf2dwg writer path, not DWG reader extraction, because its intermediate DWG lacks AcDsPrototype_1b.

Added an implementation-ready staged probe: optional pinned scratch generation; separate ASCII/Binary DXF carrier checks; verify AcDs section and owner/key associations before scoring DWG writer/reader; independent analytic and consumer gates remain separate.
Kept ACadSharp version declarations directional/version-scoped and FreeCAD as a converter-plus-selected-importer route.
Preserved no-external-fixture, fast-test-first, no-new-dependency, and non-promoting J-gate rules.
limitations: Mutable project docs and issue pages can change; future executions must pin package/source revisions and record hashes.
No issue reproduction, package, peer binary, independent kernel, or native CAD application was run.
Generated ezdxf content is a bounded sample-generation route only and cannot independently verify its own semantics.
No new result resolves native FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification, independent ACIS/ACDS semantics, or any deferred J item.
